features.feature_name: Kafka producer migration to Pub/Sub Lite
features.feature_summary: You can migrate Kafka producers to Pub/Sub Lite with only configuration changes.
features.extended_definition: You can migrate Kafka producers to Pub/Sub Lite with only configuration changes.

features.feature_summary: Export subscriptions let you export Pub/Sub Lite messages to a destination Pub/Sub topic.
features.extended_definition: Export subscriptions let you export Pub/Sub Lite messages to a destination Pub/Sub topic.

features.feature_name: Kafka Connector library for Pub/Sub and Pub/Sub Lite
features.feature_summary: The Kafka Connector library for Pub/Sub and Pub/Sub Lite is generally available; The Kafka Connector library for Pub/Sub and Pub/Sub Lite is in preview.
features.extended_definition: The Kafka Connector library for Pub/Sub and Pub/Sub Lite is generally available; The Kafka Connector library for Pub/Sub and Pub/Sub Lite is in preview.

features.feature_name: Pub/Sub Lite availability in Tel Aviv
features.feature_summary: Pub/Sub Lite is available in the Tel Aviv region (me-west1).
features.extended_definition: Pub/Sub Lite is available in the Tel Aviv region (me-west1).

features.feature_name: Kafka Shim Java client library for Pub/Sub Lite
features.feature_summary: The Kafka Shim Java client library for Pub/Sub Lite is generally available; The Kafka Shim Java client library lets you use the Kafka API with Pub/Sub Lite as a backend.
features.extended_definition: The Kafka Shim Java client library for Pub/Sub Lite is generally available; The Kafka Shim Java client library lets you use the Kafka API with Pub/Sub Lite as a backend.

features.feature_summary: Regional Lite topics replicate data to a secondary zone.
features.extended_definition: Regional Lite topics replicate data to a secondary zone.

features.feature_summary: Pub/Sub Lite reservations let you reserve and share throughput capacity among multiple topics in a region.
features.extended_definition: Pub/Sub Lite reservations let you reserve and share throughput capacity among multiple topics in a region.

features.feature_summary: The Pub/Sub Lite Python client library is generally available; The Pub/Sub Lite Python client library is available in beta.

features.feature_summary: The Pub/Sub Lite Go client library is generally available.
features.extended_definition: The Pub/Sub Lite Go client library is generally available.

features.feature_summary: Pub/Sub Lite is available in additional regions including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Osaka, Seoul, Mumbai, Jakarta, Warsaw, Montreal, Sao Paulo, Northern Virginia, Salt Lake City, and Las Vegas.
